title: Niagara Falls Tour with Boat Ride & Journey Behind the Falls
includes: Pre-reserved Niagara City Cruises Boat Tickets
Priority Boarding Access (if Upgrade option selected)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This is a walking tour, guests should be able to walk at a moderate pace, you'll cover roughly 2 Km (1 mi). We encourage appropriate footwear for uneven surfaces.
Unfortunately due to the nature of this tour it is not suitable for guests with mobility impairments or with wheelchairs.
policies: Sites on this tour are subject to occasional closures. If modifications are needed and time permits, we will reach out to you prior to your tour.
Please note - Parking is limited in Niagara Falls and lots often fill up by mid-day. We suggest taking an Uber or Taxi to the meeting point.

This tour takes place entirely outdoors, regardless of weather conditions. We recommend dressing appropriately for the season. Winter months in particular can be quite cold, be prepared to remain outside for the majority of the tour’s duration.
This tour is located in Canada, any guest arriving from the US will need a passport to enter Canada.
Please note: This tour offers multiple options. Take a moment to choose the one that best suits your interests.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embark on a Niagara Falls adventure, exploring breathtaking viewpoints of this magnificent natural wonder. After meeting your guide at the designated meeting point, you'll walk with them toward the Niagara City Cruises boat and experience the ride together. Enjoy a thrilling 20-minute cruise near the falls to see and feel the mist followed by an expert-led walking tour delving into the cultural and historical tapestry of Niagara Falls. As you approach Table Rock Visitor Center, prepare for the pinnacle experience: Journey Behind the Falls. Descend into rocky caves behind the falls themselves and feel the sheer force of cascading water up close. This tour offers the complete Niagara Falls experience, blending excitement, adventure, and expert storytelling. If you select the Niagara Falls Night Boat Tour with Fireworks Cruise option, you will enjoy an immersive night tour featuring a guided illuminated walk and a rare, once-nightly 40-minute Fireworks Cruise
